latestTerminalSummary:
## Investigator stage complete

The native Goal completed with `terminal_capture_checked=true`. The exact activation and terminal responses are saved in the stage directory. It reports **293,376 tokens** and **13m 10s** elapsed.

The draft recommends a stable attachment ID separate from the content digest, explicit extraction revisions and provenance, and stale-generation handling that prevents failed or late jobs from resurfacing old content as current. It compares FTS5, Tantivy, substring search, and optional vector search. The research reviewed FTS5’s tokenizer and synchronization limits and Tika’s OCR replacement regression history ([FTS5](https://www.sqlite.org/fts5.html), [TIKA-4883](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/TIKA-4883), [fix and tests](https://github.com/apache/tika/pull/3145/files)).
